A '''mining complex''' in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had been abandoned by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], allowing the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creature known as the [[Sand demon]] to make its home there. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]] stored the active [[Shock Drum]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in the complex, though a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was able to deactivate the weapon before it destabilized Tatooine's core.
